verdict: THE RECIPE HOLDS IN MATHS — held-out MSE falls from 3.47 (R=1 function) to 0.21 (R=32) toward the continuous-variety floor 0.19: training on a VARIETY of functions teaches the model to INFER and apply an unseen function (generalise), where few functions only memorise. The variety->generalisation recipe is DOMAIN-GENERAL (games AND symbolic maths), a clean low-noise scaling curve. (Honest: this is classic meta-learning; the point is the thesis spans domains, not ML novelty.)
